policy: Include only the bank's own current-report-year disbursed SDG-linked finance, including philanthropy. Exclude customer fund subscriptions/AUM, year-end stocks, bank-issued funding liabilities/recipient-side finance, refinancing or outstanding historic issuance, commitments or credit limits not demonstrably drawn, duplicates, and any amount whose current-year disbursement or bank-funded share remains ambiguous after source-context review. A financing verb alone cannot override an explicit credit-limit measure. Do not infer annual flows from stock differences. approved_amount_eur is the amount to use downstream: zero for excluded rows; original amount for included rows except a separately documented, source-explicit amount_adjustment. This is reported-evidence adjudication, not verification of actual impact.
scope: All 35 rows with score_eligible=true and inclusion_policy=linked_scored in the specified corrected checkpoint tree. Review is limited to cached positive finance claims and their relevant source context; missed claims, excluded/unlinked extraction rows, corpus completeness and external data were not comprehensively audited.
row_indexing: Zero-based within investments[section]. Identity is (checkpoint, section, row_index); original_evidence is an exact, unnormalized checkpoint guard.
source_page_numbering: source_pages are one-based physical PDF pages. source_page_labels separately gives the report's printed pagination, including Roman numerals and spread pages. supporting_excerpt and source_excerpts preserve source-language words and punctuation from original local PDF extraction with whitespace collapsed; ellipses in original_evidence remain untouched.

rows.original_evidence: When providing financing using this mechanism, at least 30% of funds will be allocated to finance highly‑efficient and environmentally‑friendly technologies... By the year’s end, Raiffeisen Bank has successfully utilized the funds, whose amount was increased last year to 176.3 million euros...
rows.rationale: The 'at least 30%' environmental condition belongs to the preceding EBRD Guarantee for Growth mechanism (up to EUR 75 million). EUR 176.3 million belongs to a separate EIB/EIF EU4Business SME guarantee programme, whose amount was increased 'last year'. The cached evidence joins different programmes. Utilisation by year-end does not establish EUR 176.3 million as SDG-linked bank disbursement made in 2021; neither the full amount nor a 30% allocation is verified.
rows.supporting_excerpt:
[PDF page 52; report page 52] In December 2021, Raiffeisen Bank and European Bank for Reconstruction and Development have signed, with participation of Raiffeisen Bank International AG, the Guarantee for Growth agreement (G4G Guarantee), which represents an innovative instrument developed specifically for Raiffeisen Group and Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine in particular. The purpose of this instrument is to expand cooperation in order to improve the affordability of financing for Ukrainian micro, small and medium- sized enterprises (MSMEs). Under this agreement, EBRD has issued a nonfinancial guarantee to Raiffeisen Bank in the amount of up to 75 million euros in the hryvnia,

[PDF page 52; report page 52] When providing financing using this mechanism, at least 30% of funds will be allocated to finance highly-efficient and environmentally-friendly technologies that would help achieve Ukraine’s environmental protection and climate change softening goals and would be conformant with EBRD’s Transition to the "Green Economy approach". By the year’s end, Raiffeisen Bank has successfully utilized the funds, whose amount was increased last year to 176.3 million euros, by allocating them to provide financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) under the agreement with the EIB and EIF on guarantee to Raiffeisen Bank according to EU4Business initiative.

rows.original_evidence: Загальна сума потреб – 69 тисяч гривень, … а решту профінансував Банк.
rows.rationale: The original passage states that school supplies were collected in 2023, total needs were UAH 69,000, employees raised UAH 36,000, and the bank financed the rest. The bank's explicitly attributable amount is therefore UAH 33,000, not the full UAH 69,000. Include only the documented remainder, converted with the checkpoint's existing 2023 rate: 33,000 × 0.02369 = EUR 781.77. This is a source-explicit funding split, not an assumed financing of all needs or a stock-to-flow inference.

rows.original_evidence: In 2023, 229 credit agreements for sustainable business development projects were financed for a total amount (credit limits) of over UAH 3 billion.
rows.rationale: Although the report uses 'were financed', it expressly labels the over-UAH-3-billion total as '(credit limits)'. Review of the surrounding sustainability discussion and following page does not identify how much of those limits was actually drawn in 2023. The financing verb alone is insufficient under the requested policy. Do not treat UAH 3 billion, a lower bound on limits, as a verified disbursement amount.
